mail_link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
mail_account_approved_body: Your account has been activated. You can now publish samples.
mail_invitation_body_contributor: {{inviter}} invited you to contribute to the sample "{{sample}}", which you may edit while it is a draft.
mail_invitation_body_editor: {{inviter}} invited you to edit the sample "{{sample}}", which you may also publish and keep editing afterwards.
mail_contact_subject: A visitor wants to contact you about the sample "{{sample}}"
mail_contact_body: {{visitor}} ({{email}}) sent this message about the sample "{{sample}}" ({{igsn}}). Reply to this email to answer.
mail_sample_deletion_request_subject: {{requester}} requests the deletion of the sample "{{sample}}"
mail_sample_deletion_request_body: {{requester}} requests the deletion of the sample "{{sample}}" ({{igsn}}), for this reason:
mail_manual_group_invitation_body_one: {{inviter}} added you to the group {{groups}}. You can see the groups you belong to in your settings.
mail_manual_group_invitation_body_other: {{inviter}} added you to the groups {{groups}}. You can see the groups you belong to in your settings.
mail_manual_group_request_body: {{requester}} requests the creation of the manual group "{{name}}", to be managed by {{managers}}.
mail_group_without_manager_subject: The group "{{group}}" has no active manager
mail_group_without_manager_body: The group "{{group}}" no longer has an active manager. Assign one so its accounts and samples keep being moderated.
mail_sample_moderated_subject: The sample "{{sample}}" was edited by a moderator
mail_sample_moderated_body: A moderator edited the sample "{{sample}}" you own. The information changed: {{fields}}.
mail_sample_published_subject: The sample "{{sample}}" was published by a moderator
mail_sample_published_body: A moderator published the sample "{{sample}}" you own. It now carries an IGSN, and its main information can no longer be changed.
mail_sample_withdrawn_subject: The sample "{{sample}}" was published as withdrawn by a moderator
mail_sample_withdrawn_body: A moderator published the sample "{{sample}}" you own as withdrawn. It now carries an IGSN and its main information can no longer be changed, but it stays out of public view until it is republished.
